plain_summary_en: This paper studies “Transparency is More Than a Label”: Audiences’ Information Needs for AI Use Disclosures in News. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Information needs, Work (physics), User needs, Needs assessment. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
